summary_en: 1,000,000 shares to be cancelled effective 2026-07-17. Cancellation represents 3.78% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Post-cancellation issued shares: 25,437,249; treasury shares: 7,147,567. Stated reason: capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters related to Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 9 July 2026, the board of ARBEIT-TIMES CO., LTD. (ticker 2341, TSE Standard) resolved to cancel 1,000,000 treasury shares pursuant to Companies Act Article 178. The cancellation will take effect on 17 July 2026. The shares to be cancelled represent 3.78% of issued shares outstanding (calculated on the ex-treasury base of approximately 26.44 million shares before cancellation). The stated reason is to improve capital efficiency. Following cancellation, issued shares will total 25,437,249 and treasury shares will total 7,147,567.
